news.n_amr_inca_small: Cusco is still just one of many mountain kingdoms. Its lords fight their neighbours over fields and llamas.
news.n_amr_ankara: Far beyond a sea no one here knows of, the lame conqueror Timur has crushed the army of the Turkish sultan.
news.n_amr_huitzilihuitl_cotton: They say the ruler Huitzilihuitl has married a princess of Cuauhnahuac, and now cotton is coming into the city from the warm valleys.
news.n_amr_timur_dies: On the other side of the world Timur, who terrified half the Old World, has died.
news.n_amr_zheng_he: On the far side of the great ocean the Chinese admiral Zheng He has put to sea with hundreds of huge ships.
news.n_amr_yongle_book: In distant China an encyclopedia of eleven thousand volumes has been completed. Here knowledge is kept in bark-paper books and khipu knots.
news.n_amr_tezozomoc: The Tepanec lord Tezozomoc of Azcapotzalco is the strongest ruler in the valley. The Mexica fight for him and pay him tribute.
news.n_amr_viracocha: They say the Inca Viracocha has conquered the neighbouring valleys and demands not plunder from them but a steady tribute of labour.
news.n_amr_grunwald: In the forests of distant Europe the Poles and Lithuanians have defeated the knights of the Teutonic Order.
news.n_amr_texcoco_war: Tezozomoc and Ixtlilxochitl, ruler of Texcoco, have gone to war. Canoes full of warriors dart across the lake.
news.n_amr_hus: Across the ocean, in the unknown Old World, the priest Jan Hus has been burned for arguing with the Church.
news.n_amr_ceuta: The Portuguese, people of a small country at the edge of Europe, have captured the city of Ceuta in Africa. Soon they will sail further.
news.n_amr_chimalpopoca: Young Chimalpopoca, a grandson of Tezozomoc himself, has become ruler of Tenochtitlan.
news.n_amr_ixtlilxochitl: The Tepanecs have taken Texcoco and its ruler Ixtlilxochitl is dead. They say his son escaped and swore revenge.
news.n_amr_ayarmaca: More clashes with the Ayarmaca on the pastures north of Cusco. Llamas and women are being carried off.
news.n_amr_madeira: Portuguese sailors have begun settling the empty island of Madeira in the ocean.
news.n_amr_beijing: In China the emperor has moved his capital to Beijing, to the new Forbidden City.
news.n_amr_chimor_power: Travellers from the coast tell of the kingdom of Chimor: a city of mud walls, canals in the desert and craftsmen whose gold is thinner than a leaf.
news.n_amr_tezozomoc_dies: Old Tezozomoc has died. His son Maxtla seized power in Azcapotzalco by force, and he has no love for the Mexica.
news.n_amr_chimalpopoca_dies: The ruler Chimalpopoca is dead; people whisper it was on Maxtla's orders. Itzcoatl has been chosen ruler.
news.n_amr_le_loi: In distant Đại Việt the general Lê Lợi has driven out the Chinese armies and become emperor.
news.n_amr_xochimilco: The Alliance armies have conquered Coyoacan and Xochimilco. Now flowers and vegetables from the southern chinampas come to Tenochtitlan as tribute.
news.n_amr_lupaca_colla: By the great lake Titicaca two peoples, the Lupaca and the Colla, are at war. Each seeks an alliance with Cusco.
news.n_amr_joan: In distant France they have burned Joan, a girl warrior who led armies against the English.
news.n_amr_texcoco_laws: Texcoco has proclaimed new laws: courts for nobles and commoners alike, and punishment for a judge who takes a bribe. People from other cities come there to have their cases heard.
news.n_amr_zheng_he_end: The great Chinese voyages have been stopped: the emperor has ordered that no more fleets be built.
news.n_amr_bojador: A Portuguese ship has rounded Cape Bojador off Africa, which sailors feared as the edge of the world.
news.n_amr_cuauhnahuac: The Alliance has conquered Cuauhnahuac beyond the mountains. Cotton cloaks from there now arrive as tribute.
news.n_amr_itzcoatl_dies: Itzcoatl, conqueror of Azcapotzalco, has died. Tenochtitlan is choosing a new ruler.
news.n_amr_mayapan: Merchants from the east say that in the Maya lands the great city of Mayapan has fallen and its lords have scattered to their own towns.
news.n_amr_lagos_slaves: The first captives seized on the African coast have been brought to Portugal. A long and terrible trade in people is beginning.
news.n_amr_colla_conquest: Pachacuti's armies have reached Lake Titicaca. The Colla have been conquered and their herds driven to Cusco.
news.n_amr_chalco_war: War with Chalco on the southern shore of the lake again. It has dragged on for years with no end in sight.
news.n_amr_hangul: In distant Korea King Sejong has published a new alphabet so that ordinary people can learn to read.
news.n_amr_tumu: The Mongols have defeated a Chinese army and captured the emperor himself.
news.n_amr_machu_picchu: They say the Inca is building himself a country estate on a mountain above the Urubamba river, among the clouds.
news.n_amr_gutenberg: In the German city of Mainz a craftsman named Gutenberg is printing books with metal letters.
news.n_amr_constantinople: In the Old World the Turks have taken Constantinople, the thousand-year-old capital of the Romans.
news.n_amr_roses: In England a war has begun between two royal houses, the Red Rose and the White.
news.n_amr_coixtlahuaca: Moctezuma's armies have conquered Coixtlahuaca in the Mixtec country: pochteca merchants were killed there, and the ruler took revenge.
news.n_amr_chincha: The rich coastal kingdom of Chincha has submitted to the Inca without a fight. Its seafarers on rafts trade in shells with the far north.
news.n_amr_purepecha: In the west, at Tzintzuntzan, the Purépecha have grown strong. Their warriors, they say, know how to make weapons of copper.
news.n_amr_henry_navigator: The Portuguese prince Henry, who spent his life sending ships along Africa, has died.
news.n_amr_gulf_coast: The cities by the Eastern Sea have been conquered. Vanilla pods, rubber and shells are coming from there.
news.n_amr_minchancaman: Minchancaman, king of Chimor, is gathering an army: he does not want to bow to the highlanders.
news.n_amr_chalco_falls: Chalco has finally submitted. Now the whole valley pays tribute to the Alliance.
news.n_amr_aqueduct_news: A stone aqueduct from Chapultepec now brings water into Tenochtitlan. They say the water there is now as clean as a mountain spring.
news.n_amr_onin: In distant Japan the Ōnin War has begun: lords are fighting in the very streets of the capital.
news.n_amr_timbuktu: In Africa the Songhai ruler Sonni Ali has taken Timbuktu, the city of scholars.
news.n_amr_moctezuma_dies: Moctezuma the Elder has died. Young Axayacatl has been chosen as the new ruler.
news.n_amr_ferdinand_isabella: In Spain the heirs of two kingdoms, Ferdinand and Isabella, have married. These names will be known here one day.
news.n_amr_chanchan_falls: Chan Chan, the capital of Chimor, has fallen. Its king has been taken to Cusco along with the craftsmen.
news.n_amr_nezahual_dies: News from Texcoco: Nezahualcoyotl, poet and lawgiver, has died.
news.n_amr_tlatelolco_news: Axayacatl has taken Tlatelolco. The great market now belongs to Tenochtitlan.
news.n_amr_matlatzinca: The Alliance has conquered the Toluca valley. Matlatzinca captives are being led across the causeways.
news.n_amr_sun_stone: Craftsmen have finished a huge stone disc bearing the face of the Sun and the day signs. Twenty men can barely move it.
news.n_amr_sea_voyage: Rumour has it that Topa Inca sailed out to sea on rafts and returned from islands with dark-skinned people and gold. Many do not believe it.
news.n_amr_ugra: Far in the east of the Old World Prince Ivan of Moscow has stopped paying tribute to the Horde khan.
news.n_amr_axayacatl_dies: The ruler Axayacatl has died. His brother Tizoc has been chosen ruler.
news.n_amr_inquisition: In Spain the Inquisition has begun burning people suspected of secretly keeping another faith.
news.n_amr_elmina: The Portuguese have built the stone fortress of Elmina on Africa's Gold Coast.
news.n_amr_tizoc_stone: Tizoc has ordered a huge stone carved with scenes of his victories. Wicked tongues say he has fewer victories than the stone has room for.
news.n_amr_chile: The Inca's armies have gone far south, beyond the desert, to the river Maule. Beyond it live the Mapuche, who will not surrender.
news.n_amr_bosworth: In England King Richard has fallen in battle, and the Wars of the Roses have ended.
news.n_amr_tizoc_dies: The ruler Tizoc has died suddenly. People whisper of poison. The new ruler is his brother Ahuitzotl, a warrior.
news.n_amr_oztoma: Ahuitzotl has settled colonists from the valley in the fortress of Oztoma on the Purépecha frontier.
news.n_amr_colla_revolt: The Colla by Titicaca rebelled while the Inca was in the north. They were put down and their leaders executed.
news.n_amr_dias: The Portuguese Dias has rounded the southern tip of Africa. The sea route to India lies open.
news.n_amr_kongo: The king of Kongo in Africa has been baptised by the Portuguese.
news.n_amr_granada: The Spanish monarchs have taken Granada, the last Muslim city in Spain. Ships and men are free for new ventures.
news.n_amr_columbus: On distant islands of the Eastern Sea foreigners have landed from three ships. Their leader thinks he has reached India.
news.n_amr_columbus2: The foreigners have returned to the islands to the east, now with seventeen ships, horses, pigs and seeds.
news.n_amr_ahuitzotl_south: Ahuitzotl's armies have gone far to the south, into the Zapotec country. They say they have reached the Southern Sea.
news.n_amr_tordesillas: The kings of Spain and Portugal have divided the whole undiscovered world between themselves by drawing a line on a map. No one asked us.
news.n_amr_chachapoya: Huayna Capac is leading an army against the Chachapoya, a forest people of the north-east who have rebelled more than once.
news.n_amr_guiengola: The Zapotecs are holed up in the mountain fortress of Guiengola and will not surrender. The war in the south drags on.
news.n_amr_cabot: A sailor in English service has reached cold, wooded shores far to the north.
news.n_amr_gama: The Portuguese Vasco da Gama has sailed around Africa to India.
news.n_amr_xoconochco: Xoconochco by the Southern Sea, the land of cacao and quetzal feathers, has been conquered. The pochteca rejoice.
news.n_amr_cabral: A Portuguese fleet, blown off its course to India, has come upon the coast of a huge land to the south-east.
news.n_amr_ismail: In Persia young Ismail has proclaimed himself shah.
news.n_amr_maya_canoe: Merchants from the east say that off an island near the Maya lands a trading canoe met huge floating houses full of bearded men.
news.n_amr_famine_1505: It has been a year of poor harvests. The ruler ordered the storehouses opened, but the villages are hungry all the same.
news.n_amr_tomebamba_news: The Inca is building a new city in the north, Tomebamba, said to be no less than Cusco itself.
news.n_amr_columbus_dies: In Spain Columbus has died without ever realising that what he found was not India.
news.n_amr_america_map: A German mapmaker has written the name "America" on a map for the new lands across the ocean for the first time.
news.n_amr_puerto_rico: On the island of Borikén to the east the Spaniards have founded a settlement and are dividing the local people among themselves.
news.n_amr_yahuarcocha: News from the north: after a long siege the Caranqui were defeated by a lake now called Yahuarcocha, "Lake of Blood".
news.n_amr_goa: The Portuguese have captured the city of Goa in India.
news.n_amr_aguilar: Strange rumours come from the Maya coast: the sea has cast bearded foreigners ashore, and one of them is being held captive.
news.n_amr_cuba: The Spaniards have begun conquering the great island of Cuba. The chief Hatuey, who had fled them from Hispaniola, was burned.
news.n_amr_malacca: The Portuguese have taken Malacca, the gateway to the seas of spices.
news.n_amr_huexotzinco: Noble refugees from Huexotzinco, defeated by Tlaxcala, are seeking refuge in Tenochtitlan.
news.n_amr_burgos: The Spanish king has issued laws on how to treat the island peoples. Hardly anyone intends to obey them.
news.n_amr_balboa: The Spaniard Balboa has crossed the isthmus south of here and seen another, Southern Sea.
news.n_amr_las_casas: The Spanish priest Las Casas has given up his Indians and begun preaching against his countrymen's cruelty.
news.n_amr_nezahualpilli_dies: Nezahualpilli, ruler of Texcoco, has died. His sons are quarrelling over power, and Moctezuma backs Cacama.
news.n_amr_ixtlilxochitl_ii: Prince Ixtlilxochitl has refused to recognise his brother Cacama and led his followers into the hills. Texcoco is split.
news.n_amr_cordoba: Runners from the Maya coast have told Moctezuma that floating houses came to the shore and the foreigners fought with the Maya.
news.n_amr_luther: In Germany a monk named Luther has spoken out against the sale of indulgences. The Spaniards' Church is splitting.
news.n_amr_cairo: The Turks have conquered Egypt and Cairo.
news.n_amr_grijalva: Tribute collectors on the Eastern Sea have seen foreigners in big boats. Moctezuma ordered them drawn and the pictures sent to him.
news.n_amr_smallpox_hispaniola: Smallpox has broken out on the islands to the east. The islanders are dying by the thousands.
news.n_amr_cholula: Terrible news from Cholula: the foreigners and the Tlaxcalans killed a great many people in the courtyard of the Feathered Serpent's temple.
news.n_amr_panama: On the isthmus to the south the Spaniards have founded the town of Panama on the shore of the Southern Sea.
news.n_amr_magellan: Five Spanish ships under the Portuguese Magellan have put to sea to go round the world westward.
news.n_amr_moctezuma_dies2: News from Tenochtitlan: Moctezuma is dead and the foreigners fled the city by night.
news.n_amr_chiriguano: On the eastern frontier, by the forests, the Chiriguano are raiding. The Inca is building fortresses there.
news.n_amr_suleiman: In Turkey Sultan Suleiman has come to the throne.
news.n_amr_magellan_strait: Far to the south Magellan's ships have found a strait between the oceans at the very end of this land.
news.n_amr_magellan_dies: On islands far across the Southern Sea Magellan has been killed in battle with a local chief.
news.n_amr_mexico_city: On the ruins of Tenochtitlan the foreigners are building their own city. They take the stone for it from the destroyed temples.
news.n_amr_andagoya: Far to the north, by a sea little known here, bearded foreigners are asking about a rich land called Peru.
news.n_amr_elcano: A single ship from Magellan's fleet has returned to Spain, having sailed around the whole world.
news.n_amr_alvarado_guatemala: A Spanish captain, nicknamed "the Sun" here for his golden hair, has marched south with an army into the lands of the K'iche' Maya.
news.n_amr_utatlan: News from the south: the K'iche' city of Q'umarkaj has been burned by the Spaniards and its rulers executed.
news.n_amr_aleixo_garcia: Strange news from the eastern frontier: forest people attacked the fortresses, and a bearded foreigner was with them.
news.n_amr_balsa_raft: Seafarers from a balsa raft say that a huge ship overtook them at sea; bearded men took the cargo and carried some of them away.
news.n_amr_babur: In India Babur has defeated the Sultan of Delhi at Panipat and founded a new empire.
news.n_amr_montejo: The Spaniards have landed on the Maya peninsula, but the Maya will not give in: in the hot forests the war goes on for years.
news.n_amr_tumbes: Foreigners have sailed into Tumbes on the coast. They were shown the city and the temple, and they stared at the gold for a long time.
news.n_amr_sack_rome: The emperor's mercenaries have sacked Rome, the city of the Spaniards' high priest.
news.n_amr_audiencia: Spanish judges have arrived from across the sea. They say they are greedier than the old masters, and even the friars complain about them to the king.
news.n_amr_sahagun: A young friar has arrived who asks the old people about the old gods, festivals and herbs and writes everything down in our language.
news.n_amr_toledo: Somewhere beyond the seas the king of the Spaniards signed a paper giving the Inca realm to a man named Pizarro. No one here knows it.
news.n_amr_vienna: The Turks have besieged Vienna but failed to take it.
news.n_amr_michoacan: News from the west: a cruel Spanish judge has executed the lord of the Purépecha, even though he had submitted without a fight.
news.n_amr_puebla: The Spaniards have founded a new town in the valley near Cholula, just for themselves.
news.n_amr_guadalupe: They say that on the hill of Tepeyac a dark-skinned Virgin appeared to a humble Indian. The friars argue over whether to believe it.
news.n_amr_puna: On the island of Puná off the coast the foreigners are fighting the locals. They are few, but they have thunder weapons and huge animals.
news.n_amr_piura: The foreigners have built a settlement of their own in the north by the desert and are moving into the mountains.
news.n_amr_atahualpa_executed: Atahualpa is dead: the foreigners took the ransom gold and executed him anyway.
news.n_amr_cartier: The Frenchman Cartier has sailed to a great river in the far north of this land.
news.n_amr_lima: The Spaniards have founded their new capital by the sea, Lima. Cusco is no longer the capital.
news.n_amr_manco_news: News from the south: Manco Inca has risen and besieged Cusco.
news.n_amr_almagro: The Spaniards are fighting each other: Almagro has returned from his southern expedition and seized Cusco by force.
news.n_amr_sublimis: The Spaniards' high priest in Rome has declared that the Indians are people with souls and may not be enslaved.
news.n_amr_las_salinas: Near Cusco Spaniards fought Spaniards. Almagro has been defeated and executed.
news.n_amr_printing: In the Spaniards' city a press has been set up that makes books without a scribe, impression after impression.
news.n_amr_mixton: In the north-west the Caxcan Chichimecs have risen. The Spanish captain who once helped destroy Tenochtitlan died there.
news.n_amr_pizarro_killed: Francisco Pizarro himself has been killed in Lima, stabbed by followers of the executed Almagro.
news.n_amr_de_soto: Spaniards wandering the northern lands have reached the huge river Mississippi.
news.n_amr_merida: The Spaniards have founded a city on the site of Maya T'hó. The Maya peninsula is submitting.
news.n_amr_amazon: Spaniards who left Quito in search of pepper and cinnamon have gone down a huge river through the forests all the way to the sea.
news.n_amr_new_laws: The Spanish king has issued the "New Laws", forbidding the enslavement of Indians and ordering that the conquistadors' encomiendas be gradually taken away.
news.n_amr_copernicus: The scholar Copernicus in distant Poland claims that the Earth goes around the Sun. Priests here have long watched the Sun, but never said that.
news.n_amr_manco_killed: In the mountains of Vilcabamba Spanish fugitives whom Manco had sheltered killed him.
news.n_amr_trent: The priests of the Spaniards' faith have gathered for a great council to answer Luther's followers.
news.n_amr_zacatecas: Far to the north, among the Chichimecs, veins of silver have been found. Porters are being driven there.
news.n_amr_inaquito: Near Quito Gonzalo Pizarro defeated the viceroy's army, and the viceroy himself was beheaded.
news.n_amr_ivan_tsar: In distant Muscovy Prince Ivan has been crowned tsar.
news.n_amr_gonzalo: The rebel Gonzalo Pizarro has been defeated and executed. The Spaniards' country again has a single master, the king.
news.n_amr_xavier: A Spanish Jesuit monk has sailed to Japan to preach.
news.n_amr_valladolid: In Spain learned men are debating before the king whether the Indians are fully people and whether war on them for the faith is just. Las Casas defends them.
news.n_amr_university: The king of the Spaniards has ordered a great school, a university, opened in the city to teach law and religion.
news.n_amr_san_marcos: A university, a great Spanish school, has been opened in Lima.
news.n_amr_flood_1555: Water has flooded the Spaniards' city again. The old people recall that Nezahualcoyotl's dike was taken apart long ago.
news.n_amr_akbar: In India young Akbar has come to the throne.
news.n_amr_sayri_tupac: Manco's son Sayri Túpac has come out of Vilcabamba and accepted lands and a title from the Spaniards.
news.n_amr_taki_onqoy: People possessed by the "dancing sickness" are going from village to village: they say the huacas have returned and will soon drive out the Spaniards.
news.n_amr_tupac_amaru: The Spaniards have taken Vilcabamba. The last Inca, Túpac Amaru, was executed on the square in Cusco.
